4492.title: Image editor action can prepare terminal directory launch
4492.rootCauseConfidence: High for UI label, explicit preference and recorded invocation
4492.rootCauseOneLine: Generic editor label permits explicit terminal file targets; Ghostty without a terminal editor receives the containing directory.
4492.proposedFix: Use target-aware image action labels and a separate default-app action; preserve explicit preference intent.
caveats: No native app execution or real macOS discovery.
Automatic image fallback selects default-app despite Ghostty workspace preference.
Detected terminal editor changes invocation; no claim all configurations open only a directory.
